title: Raw Material Demand Predictor
short: Turns the production plan and sales forecast into raw-material and packaging-material requirements, with shortage and expiry alerts.
symptom: Production stops because one excipient ran out
directions: Connect the production plan, bills of materials and stock. Get time-phased material needs, reorder dates and expiry risks.
problem: APIs, excipients and packaging materials have long and variable lead times, minimum order quantities and retest dates; a single missing material can stop a batch.
why: Material shortages stop production; over-buying ties up cash and leads to expired or re-tested stock.
solution: Explodes forecast production through bills of materials, compares requirements with stock, open orders, retest/expiry dates and supplier lead times, and recommends what to order and when.
data: Material stock, retest/expiry dates, open purchase orders, lead times
limitations: Depends on accurate bills of materials and stock records
Supplier disruptions can exceed any forecast
review: Buyers and planners approve every purchase; QA status of materials is never overridden.
